### What is constrained?

$$
\pi^0\to\gamma\gamma,\qquad
\gamma\gamma_{\mathrm{EBL}}\to e^+e^-,\qquad
e^\pm\gamma_{\mathrm{bg}}\to e^\pm\gamma
$$

Escaping high-energy photons feed a lower-energy electromagnetic cascade.

| Input | Constraint |
|:---|:---|
| Measured neutrino spectrum | Pion production and its energy dependence |
| Fermi isotropic gamma-ray background | A ceiling on the accompanying extragalactic cascade |
| Internal photon absorption | Redistribution of photon energy before escape |

Other source populations also contribute to the gamma-ray background.

### Photon opacity

$$
\gamma+\gamma\to e^++e^-,\qquad
E_\gamma\epsilon\gtrsim(m_ec^2)^2\quad\text{(head-on)}
$$

| Condition | Meaning |
|:---|:---|
| Above pair-production threshold | Absorption is kinematically allowed |
| $\tau_{\gamma\gamma}\gtrsim1$ | Photon density and path length make it effective |
| Pair cooling and further interactions | Energy emerges at different photon energies |

Neutrino escape depends on the matter column as well.
